_doc: Board qualification is derived: every protection type in the graph (including LSID) must compile without refusals and be in this build's units_at_parity, the silent DT/tuning wiring self-check must pass for this board, blob hash and kernel release, and the verified extraction record must bind the tuning to this Mac's own macOS. Missing, failed or stale records keep the speakers muted on v2 kernels. denied_boards and board_overrides (allow/deny) are policy only: deny wins, and allow never bypasses compilation, parity, provenance or self-check. Provisioning and self-check may run before qualification; only a current qualified record admits the supervisor. LSID is not at parity: K114/K116 remain muted.
_voicing_pre_doc: Full generated voicing deployment overrides per physical board: literal true enables it, false keeps the interim convolver. At runtime a board without an override automatically compiles its own full chain; offline fixture artifacts retain their recorded mode. SPP3V owns promotion after numerical/acoustic qualification. Provision again after any change.

History: Interim never-louder bound (Ryan 2026-11-07: Plan A tonight on all four boards, open laws in their never-louder form): one gain in dB per unit lane, applied by the PipeWire voicing graph after the voicing plugin, so no lane of the generated voicing is louder than macOS while the Comp onset/param-69 (all four), AID44 q2 detector laws are still open (j413 woofers: -1.09 dB since the exact LowFlow landed, 2026-11-08, covering the Comp onset excess the exact LowFlow now passes through). _voicing_pre_lowpass_doc: INTERIM never-louder band limit, not a macOS law (AUD-CUT2 2026-11-07, Ryan's parity rule: never-louder is fine as interim). {hz, order}: an even-order Butterworth low-pass built from PipeWire bq_lowpass sections in FRONT of the voicing plugin. j700 only: v2's AID44 ControlFreak lacks the AU's reconstruction low-pass, so above ~17 kHz the box is up to +23 dB (+30 dB at 0 dBFS) louder than macOS and its saturation aliases a loud high-frequency input into 9-16.5 kHz; the lane trim cannot hold either. 17.4 kHz order 8 (with the j700 trim): AID44 box rig (installed AU, 362 tones/pink/steps incl. 16-23.75 kHz probes) 0 louder cases, worst -0.58 dB; full AID44 voicing VLS 30 Hz-19.5 kHz 0 louder bands, worst -0.03 dB; cost at 16 kHz -0.1 dB. Goes when the ControlFreak law is exact (Daybreak t-5511). 2026-11-08: no board carries it; the AID44 ControlFreak saturation, reconstruction and drive laws are exact on the box rig (steady and 20 kHz), so the j700 trim alone (-0.35 dB from the AID44 VLS, worst +0.311) holds.
_hardware_qualified_doc: Boards v2 may govern (2026-11-09, after an unqualified j414s buzzed and crackled under v2): each passed our hardware qualification on a lab Mac (audible and sensed checks against its own macOS, rig and scanner parity). Every other board keeps the older daemons (speakersafetyd, speakerguardd 0.1), whatever its tuning and silent self-check say. A board is added only with its hardware qualification record. Missing or malformed: no board qualifies. An allow override does not add a board.
